# 台积电 Q2 法说会前瞻：AI 芯片需求、CoWoS 产能与 2nm 进展
## CoWoS 产能为何是 AI 芯片交付的关键瓶颈

# 2026年CoWoS产能，被谁瓜分？
### 01 2026年CoWoS产能，被谁瓜分？
作为台积电在“超越摩尔定律”道路上的核心技术，Chip-on-Wafer（CoW）工艺将多个芯片（如GPU、CPU和HBM等）堆叠并键合到硅中介晶圆上；然后，再将CoW芯片与封装基板（Substrate）整合，形成完整的CoWoS封装结构。

这意味着它允许将采用5nm/3nm先进制程的GPU计算单元、专为存储优化的HBM芯片，以及成熟制程的I/O接口芯片整合为单一系统级封装，在性能、功耗与成本间找到最佳平衡点。

这笔庞大的订单中，约51万片将由台积电承接，主要用于下一代Rubin架构芯片。

其产能主要服务于大客户的定制芯片（ASIC），包括为谷歌TPU预订的9万片（台积电8.5万片，日月光/矽品5千片）、为Meta预订的5万片，以及为OpenAI预订的1万片。

其中，8万片将在台积电生产，用于其MI355和MI400系列AI加速器。

### 03 先进封装，三强混战
台积电方面，有一点需要特别注意，台积电2026年CoWoS产能的大客户大都属于美国公司，如今美国客户希望实现全产业链的在美生产，但台积电和上下游暂无可用的在美后端产能。

今年中旬，市场消息称台积电正在大规模推进在美生产计划，包括建设晶圆厂、研发中心和先进封装设施。 除芯片制造外，CoWoS等先进封装技术是供应链中最关键的环节之一。

这座先进封装工厂将负责生产CoWoS及其衍生技术，以及SoIC和CoW等下一代封装方案，这些技术将应用于英伟达Rubin系列和AMD Instinct MI400等产品线。

与此同时，EMIB的崛起并不意味着CoWoS的衰落，而是先进封装行业迈入场景化精准匹配的新发展阶段。

Micron’s [**HBM4 12-high volume ramp**](https://tradethepool.com/fundamental/nvidia-earnings-reports-the-power-play-behind-vera-rubin/) progresses at twice the speed of its predecessor, HBM3E 12-high. ### HBM4E: Next-Generation Development
Each generation of HBM carries a higher trade ratio, meaning it consumes a larger share of total DRAM wafer output for the same number of bits. **Consequently, this dynamic structurally constrains non-HBM DRAM supply as HBM demand scales.**

### Supply Constraints: Structural, Not Cyclical
Mehrotra stated clearly that Micron does not currently have **“line of sight as to when memory supply will be able to catch up with increasing demand.”** The company now expects tight supply-demand conditions for both DRAM and NAND to persist beyond calendar 2027. Therefore, supply tightness is not a short-term imbalance — it is a multi-year structural condition.

Here is my take on the Micron earnings from this evening. The headline for me is that “supply is structurally constrained”. The management detailed how both DRAM and NAND supply will remain tight beyond calendar 2027. Later they detailed how they see tightness continuing beyond 2027.

Micron’s expansion efforts are timed well with some new fab capacity coming online in mid-2027 and through 2028. From my perspective, I like this aggressive expansion plan Micron has laid out as it does not seem like the supply shortage is going away any time soon.

- 2027 overall tight supply, “tightness continuing beyond 2027”
- “So supply even in 2028, when supply begins to improve gradually, we see that demand will continue to be on a robust trajectory as well because these AI trends are very long-term trends. AI is still very, very early innings.”

It is incredible that even at Micron’s already massive scale, they have “no line of sight” when the increasing demand will end.
